annotations.title: Search data tasks and provider tools

description: Search Ahel's catalog of data tasks and provider tools by words, a task id or a tool id: company and people enrichment, SEO, social, ads, e-commerce, reviews, AI generation, market and public data. Each result has its genuine task id or tool id, its platform, its status (ready, coming_soon meaning temporarily unavailable because Ahel has no provider for it yet, or unavailable while the run service is down) with the exact reason; a temporarily unavailable result may carry a market price seen elsewhere, for comparison. The same catalog, ids and statuses as the Catalog page on ahel.ai. Describe the job in plain words; results are ranked by how well they fit. When nothing fits it answers verdict none with the three nearest items: then call catalog_request. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: one item's exact inputs and prices, which is capability_inspect, or the team's own tools, which is my_tools.

kind.description: Optional: only tasks or only provider tools.

platform.description: Optional platform id (companies, google, image-gen): only its items; with no query, its whole shelf.

query.description: Words to match, or an exact task id (companies.enrich) or tool id.

status.description: Optional: only items in this state.
